hypotheses.A0_midpoint_jvp_is_numerically_correct: The analytic midpoint product JVP has cosine at least 0.999 and relative error at most 0.02 against a centered finite difference in every cell.
hypotheses.A1_exact_local_router_recovers_the_downs: Choosing among rotated bases by endpoint local-write fidelity comes within 0.05 of the downstream best-of-seven median and agrees with its basis on at least 30% of examples in every cell.
hypotheses.A2_midpoint_router_tracks_the_exact_loca: The midpoint-JVP rotated-basis router is within 0.05 downstream fidelity of the exact-local router and agrees with its basis on at least 30% of examples in every cell.
hypotheses.A3_midpoint_adaptive_dictionary_beats_na: The midpoint-selected rotated basis beats the native rank-256 program by at least 0.03 with pair-bootstrap 95% interval above zero in every cell.
hypotheses.A4_midpoint_router_closes_half_the_adapt: Relative to the best fixed rotation, the midpoint router closes at least half of the gap to the per-example downstream best-of-seven rotation in every cell.
hypotheses.A5_native_wins_when_it_is_a_router_candi: When native is included with seven rotations, midpoint local fidelity chooses native on at least half of examples in every cell.
hypotheses.A6_adaptive_rotation_is_not_a_sparse_nat: Every midpoint-selected rotated rank-256 patch has at least 75% of native coordinates above 1e-4 of its maximum absolute coordinate.
hypotheses.A7_router_behavior_transfers_ood: The FineWeb-versus-TinyStories difference in midpoint-router minus native fidelity is at most 0.10 at each layer.
